title: Amelia | Everyday tote with effortless style
bodyHtml:
A bag that gets better with time. This isn't a trend – it's the real deal. Designed to slip seamlessly into your life, our tote works just as well for a Saturday farmers market run as it does for the office, and it ages beautifully so you'll love it more each year. The thoughtful sizing (23cm H × 23cm W) means it holds what matters without the bulk.

Why you'll love it

  • Timeless design that works with everything in your wardrobe, season after season
  • Soft, supple construction that develops character as you wear it – honestly gets better with age
  • Beautifully hand-finished, with every seam and detail showing real craftsmanship
  • All-day comfortable carry – sized just right, not too big, not too small
  • An investment piece that'll still be going strong in years to come
  • Looks equally at home in Melbourne laneways or Byron Bay beach towns
  • The kind of everyday essential you'll actually reach for

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
